record.reason: MSJoE jointly trains an MLLM and frame sampler. It improves video QA, but its efficiency appendix reports total time about 30% above uniform sampling even though the QA step is 10% faster through prefix-cache hits; the net pipeline efficiency is therefore workload-dependent.
record.title: MSJoE: Jointly Evolving MLLM and Sampler for Efficient Long-Form Video Understanding
